errorCases.when: No Authorization header or a non-Bearer scheme. Applied by the gateway default-deny authGate and again by the route's requireAuth preHandler.
verifyJwt() rejects the bearer token — tampered signature, wrong secret, or expired exp claim.

req.params.id is falsy. Practically unreachable through the router (an empty :id segment matches the sibling GET /api/agent-runtime/agents collection route instead); reachable when the handler is called directly.

The id is a syntactically valid UUID but no row exists in agents.agent_definition. Note this lookup is by agent_id ONLY — it is not tenant-scoped, so a caller with any valid tenant JWT can read another tenant's agent definition; the 404 is purely existence-based.
The SELECT throws. Dominant real case: :id is not a valid UUID (e.g. 'abc' or a truncated id) — Postgres raises 'invalid input syntax for type uuid', which surfaces as 500 rather than 400/404.
Route-level try/catch in registerRoutes — an error thrown outside the handler's own catch, with no reply already sent.
